description: Use for scheduling across time zones: takes a wall-clock time in a source zone (or an ISO instant with offset) and returns the same instant in each target zone with date, weekday, UTC offset and DST flag, plus the UTC instant. Handles daylight-saving transitions correctly (times in a spring-forward gap move to the first valid instant and are flagged). Paid tool: x402 USDC on Base, $0.001 per successful call; call without payment to receive the PaymentRequired object.

from.description: IANA zone of "time" (ignored if time has an offset).

time.description: Local time "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM[:SS]" in "from", or an ISO instant with Z/offset.
